McCormick creates flavors for a wide range of applications, such as beverages, snacks, dairy, bakery/confectionary, savory, performance nutrition, and health. 

The McCormick name represents a trusted source of flavor in millions of kitchens around the globe—in homes and in restaurants. Partnerships with farmers and suppliers around the world allow us to provide great-tasting, quality spices with year-over-year consistency that you can trust.

Our herbs and spices come from over 91 different countries, while our brands reach consumers in more than 150 countries and territories. Our passion for quality is matched only by our commitment to an innovative and energetic company culture. At McCormick, we believe in respect, recognition, inclusion, and collaboration, based on the highest ethical values for our employees.

McCormick is a team of 14,000 employees located around the world—and we’re growing.  If you have a passion for flavor—and you’re ready to take a journey—come have a seat at our table.

name: Dignifyd
d:
Dignifyd began as a small vision in a single room of a humble home — a design-tech studio fueled by creativity, curiosity, and the belief that innovation could be both beautiful and powerful. What started as a passion project soon evolved into a global collective of ventures, each dedicated to transforming how businesses connect, create, and grow in the modern world.

Rooted in technology, design, and purpose, Dignifyd Group today spans diverse verticals — Dignifyd Tech, Dignifyd Digital, Dignifyd Talent Connect, and Dignifyd SAP — each built on the same founding principle: to deliver meaningful impact through innovation and integrity.

From developing next-generation technology platforms to building digital-first brand ecosystems, Dignifyd empowers businesses across the globe to scale smarter, faster, and more sustainably. Our teams blend creativity with data, design with engineering, and human insight with automation — crafting solutions that are not only efficient but truly transformative.

Headquartered across the UK, UAE, India, and the US, Dignifyd has grown into a multidisciplinary powerhouse — partnering with enterprises, startups, and public institutions to redefine digital transformation, marketing, consulting, and enterprise enablement.

What makes Dignifyd unique isn’t just what we build — it’s how we began. Our journey from a single desk and an idea to a global innovation ecosystem reflects our relentless belief that great things start small, but with purpose, they grow beyond boundaries.

At the heart of it all, we remain dreamers, builders, and believers — committed to designing the future, empowering people, and dignifying the world of business.

As part of DHL Group’s DHL eCommerce division, Blue Dart accesses the largest and most comprehensive express and logistics network worldwide, covering over 220 countries and territories, and offers an entire spectrum of distribution services including air express, freight forwarding, supply chain solutions, customs clearance etc.

The Blue Dart team drives market leadership through its motivated people, dedicated air and ground capacity, cutting-edge technology, wide range of innovative, vertical specific products and value-added services to deliver unmatched standards of service quality to its customers. Blue Dart's market leadership is further validated by its position as the nation’s most innovative and awarded express logistics company for exhibiting reliability, superior brand experience and sustainability which include recognition as one of ‘India's Best Companies to Work For’ by The Great Place to Work® Institute, India, ranked amongst ‘Best Multinational Workplaces in Asia’ by The Great Place to Work® Institute, Asia, voted a ‘Superbrand’ and ‘Reader’s Digest Most Trusted Brand’, listed as one of Fortune 500’s ‘India's Largest Corporations’ and Forbes ‘India's Super 50 Companies’ to name a few. Blue Dart’s Diversity and Inclusion initiatives have also led to it being recognized as one of India’s ‘Best Workplaces for Women’ in 2021 and ‘Best Organizations for Women’ in 2022 by the Economic Times.

Blue Dart fulfils its social responsibility of climate protection (GoGreen), disaster management (GoHelp) and education (GoTeach) through its GoPrograms.

name: Asian Paints
d:
They say home is where the heart is. Which is why, since 1942, we’ve been helping customers transform empty properties to homes by dressing them up in warm hues, pastel shades and cool colours, to create spaces that truly represent you.
Asian Paints has a lot of identities. We have been India’s largest paint company for almost 50 years and are part of the top 10 decorative paint companies worldwide. We have operations in 14 countries, and manufacturing facilities in 27 global locations. Having subsidiaries in India and abroad, Asian Paints encompasses the best of Indian and global traits, homegrown and international qualities. Our subsidiaries are Berger International, Scib, Taubman, Apco, Ess Ess. We have joint ventures with PPG in automotive and industrial paints and Sleek International Modular Kitchens. 
With different strokes for all types of folks, we have paints ranging from luxury enamels to economic quality distemper in all shades imaginable.
Despite our phenomenal growth in the paint segment, we didn’t just stop there. We expanded with our wallpaper range - Nilaya, wall stencils, wood finishes, adhesives and waterproofing solutions. We listened to our customers when they asked for hassle-free painting services and now provide end-to-end servicing in multiple cities. We constantly innovate with service offerings – from colour consultancy at home, online consultancy services, to providing inspiration centres through Colour stores.
Our reputation often precedes us but we have never let that be our resting laurel. We constantly strive to push boundaries – not only by creating more sustainable ways of carrying out extensive community initiatives that touch the lives of people, but also through our operations. Our people are passionate, innovative and work with integrity. Our actions reflect these values and our businesses across the globe ensure they maintain the quality of work and standards of excellence we are known for.

Stay Alert: Avoid Recruitment Scams
 
Across industries, cybercriminals are posing as company recruiters using fake job postings and employment offers to trick people into providing personal information or payment. Be alert and never provide personal/financial information or payment to anyone claiming to offer a job opportunity. During the recruiting process, RSM US will never: 
 
	• Ask you for payment to process documents, purchase equipment, or for any other reason.
	• Request your banking or credit card information
	• Send you a check to purchase your own equipment 
 
If you believe you are a victim of a job scam, it’s recommended that you report it to law enforcement, contact your financial institution and notify the website in which the job was listed.

name: Adbunny
d:
Most ad stacks pass on a third of their impressions. Thin demand, odd hours, the wrong geo — and the slot goes dark. AdBunny exists for that exact moment: when everyone else passes, your inventory still earns.

We built an AI layer that sits underneath your existing ad stack and evaluates real-time demand for every single impression — serving whichever banner is likely to pay the most, right now, instead of following a fixed, outdated waterfall.

How it works: One JS tag. Same-day setup. Zero conflict with your existing demand partners. AdBunny acts as a secondary layer, only serving ads when your primary stack passes on an impression. No SDK, no server-side changes, no engineering sprint required.

The results: Publishers on our network see fill rates go from ~35% (the industry standard with static waterfalls) to ~89% on remnant inventory — with real-time performance reporting on every impression.

Who we work with: Publishers looking to monetize unsold ad space without adding ad-ops workload, and ad networks seeking programmatic access to aggregated remnant banner inventory across our network through a single integration.

Traditional waterfalls call the same demand sources in the same fixed order, regardless of what would actually pay best for that impression. Our AI evaluates live demand per impression in real time — so nothing sits unsold that doesn't have to.

One tag. AI-driven optimization. Revenue from inventory that used to sit empty.

name: Nekofi
d:
Nekofi is India's first 100% Ethiopian specialty instant coffee brand — Built for the people who love good coffee but were quietly locked out of it.

Good coffee has been held hostage by equipment for too long. The travel grinder. The kettle held to the half-degree. Beans weighed to the tenth of a gram. A beautiful subculture, with an identity tax attached. We asked a simpler question: what if a genuinely specialty cup required none of that?

Nekofi is the answer. Single-origin Ethiopian coffees — Guji (light), Sidama (medium), and the Nekofi Blend (dark) — hand-picked ripe, sun-dried on raised beds, SCA-scored 80+, and vacuum freeze-dried at −80°C into 3g pods. Over 92% of the original flavour and aroma survives the process. No grinder, no kettle, no membership required. Just pour.

Alongside the coffee, we run two sister programmes:

Nekofi Brew bar — a curated shelf of exclusive tools and gadgets for baristas, plus an open library of Protocols (recipes, techniques, brew methods) built on an eight-facet taxonomy for the people who want to go deeper.

Sensory Sessions — a ninety-minute, five-seat Palate Calibration coffee Workshop/experience. Learn about your palate and know your coffee better with this program. The lesson is bigger than coffee.

And we close the loop. Every Nekofi cup gets a second life — either upcycled at home under #NekofiCreator, or mailed back through our free 50-cup pickup and returned to the supply chain as new pods. Actual loop. No greenwash.

Founded by Parmit Dabas — host of the Spillinbean Podcast and co-founder of Delhi Coffee Collective — Nekofi is what happens when the shelf you want to buy from doesn't exist, so you build it.

Live it kawaii. Pour it slow. 🐱
s: Speciality Instant coffee and Sensory products

name: Roche
d:
Roche ist ein globales Unternehmen mit Vorreiterrolle in der Erforschung und Entwicklung von Medikamenten und Diagnostika und ist darauf fokussiert, Menschen durch wissenschaftlichen Fortschritt ein besseres, längeres Leben zu ermöglichen. Dank der Kombination von Pharma und Diagnostika unter einem Dach ist Roche führend in der personalisierten Medizin - einer Strategie mit dem Ziel, jeder Patientin und jedem Patienten die bestmögliche Behandlung zukommen zu lassen.

Roche ist das grösste Biotech-Unternehmen weltweit mit differenzierten Medikamenten für die Onkologie, Immunologie, Infektionskrankheiten, Augenheilkunde und Erkrankungen des Zentralnervensystems. Roche ist auch der bedeutendste Anbieter von In-vitro-Diagnostika und gewebebasierten Krebstests und ein Pionier im Diabetesmanagement.
Seit der Gründung im Jahr 1896 erforscht Roche bessere Wege, um Krankheiten zu verhindern, zu erkennen und zu behandeln und leistet einen nachhaltigen Beitrag zur gesellschaftlichen Entwicklung. Zum Ziel des Unternehmens gehört es durch Kooperationen mit allen relevanten Partnern den Zugang von Patienten zu medizinischen Innovationen zu verbessern.

Auf der Liste der unentbehrlichen Arzneimittel der Weltgesundheitsorganisation stehen heute 30 von Roche entwickelte Medikamente, darunter lebensrettende Antibiotika, Malariamittel und Krebsmedikamente. Ausgezeichnet wurde Roche zudem bereits das neunte Jahr in Folge als das nachhaltigste Unternehmen innerhalb der Pharma-, Biotechnologie- und Life-Sciences-Branche im Dow Jones Sustainability Index.

Die Roche-Gruppe mit Hauptsitz in Basel, Schweiz ist in über 100 Ländern tätig und beschäftigte 2017 weltweit rund 94 000 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter. Im Jahr 2017 investierte Roche CHF 10,4 Milliarden in Forschung und Entwicklung und erzielte einen Umsatz von CHF 53,3 Milliarden. Genentech in den USA gehört vollständig zur Roche-Gruppe. Roche ist Mehrheitsaktionär von Chugai Pharmaceutical, Japan. Weitere Informationen finden Sie unter www.roche.com/careers

name: Vortex Studios
d:
We don't really know how to do things normally.
We believe normal is useful. It keeps things moving. It gets things approved. But we're rather more interested in what happens after that.

The idea that arrives at 2:00 a.m. The reference nobody understands yet. The stupid thought that somehow turns out to be the best one. The shot that wasn't in the plan. The version that makes everyone go:

“Wait. Why haven't we seen this before?”
That's the stuff we like.

Because marketing isn't really about keeping up with what's trending. It's about understanding why someone stops. Why they laugh. Why they look twice. Why something stays in their head. Why, for a few seconds, a brand actually means something to them.

So we start there.

Sometimes with a film. Sometimes with a photograph. Sometimes with design, sound, music, animation, humor, a strange combination of all of them. Sometimes with a very simple idea.

And then we make it unnecessarily interesting.
We pull it apart. Put it back together. Argue about it. Shoot it. Reshoot it. Cut it at stupid hours. Change the music. Kill the idea. Bring it back. Find something better.

Not because more is always better.
Because somewhere inside all that mess, there is usually a version that feels undeniably right.

That's what we're looking for.
Not another piece of content. Not another polished campaign. Not something that looks like something we've already seen.

Something that feels like it had to exist.
And yes, we make films. Advertising. Branded content. Documentaries. Photography. Design. Animation. Whatever else the idea demands.

The medium is just the medium.
The idea gets to decide.
We take the promise seriously. But we don't take the obvious answer seriously enough.
That's Vortex.

A little obsessive. A little unreasonable. Very curious.
And always looking for the stuff that does not exist yet.

name: Dandelion Civilization
d:
Dandelion Civilization is a science-based behavioral intelligence platform that helps organizations hire and build stronger teams by revealing how people actually think, decide, and perform at work - not just what appears on their CV.

In a hiring landscape increasingly shaped by AI-generated CVs and polished interviews, traditional recruitment methods offer only a surface-level view of candidates. This creates costly blind spots, leaving businesses vulnerable to mis-hires that reduce productivity, disrupt team cohesion, and impact business performance.

Dandelion Civilization replaces these blind spots with scientifically grounded insight. Built on validated behavioral science and delivered through AI-powered digital workplace simulations, the platform analyzes how candidates make decisions, respond to challenges, and operate in realistic job scenarios, before a hiring decision is made.

Beyond recruitment, Dandelion’s behavioral risk management engine transforms static HR data into continuous, actionable intelligence. Instead of relying on a one-time assessment snapshot, organizations gain an evolving view of how individuals and teams perform, adapt, and influence business outcomes over time.

The result is faster hiring, stronger role fit and reduced behavioral risk. By turning human behavior into measurable data, Dandelion Civilization enables businesses to treat human capital as a strategic, quantifiable asset - driving smarter talent decisions and long-term organizational performance.
s: ‏HR Technology، Talent Management، Human Capital Management، Resource Allocation، Organizational Psychology، Talent Acquisition، و Behavioral Intelligence‏

d:
Khanna Polyrib Pvt. Ltd. was incorporated in the year 1992 and started commercial production in January 1995 with a capacity of 5 TPD of Polymer.  Khanna business group has been in the polymer business since 1964 and has three manufacturing Units – Two Units of Engineering Plastic products and on Unit for manufacturing of sheets and Blocks. Khanna Polyrib Pvt Ltd. has facility to produce sheets and blocks by Compression Moulding Process and extrusion Process.  The major items of production of Khanna Polyrib Pvt Ltd are –

- Polypropylene, HDPE, Poly Propylene Glass Lined, ABS and POM sheets.
- UHMW, HDPE and PP Compressed Sheets/ Blocks up to 200mm thickness and Cutting Boards.
- PP Glow Sign Sheets
- UHMW Rods, PP Rods, Liners and Perforated Plates
- Extruded Sheets, Profiles and Sections
- PP, PPGL and HDPE Sheets Welding Rods. 
- POM sheets
During the year 2013, the Company has added a new most modern Sheet Line Plant where sheets of 0.5mm thickness can also be manufactured with the introduction of this machine, the daily production capacity has increased to many folds.

 
The products of the company are used in a host of industries such as Steel Plants, Foundries Bulk conveyor Systems, Cement, Fertilizer, Pharmaceuticals, Chemicals, Automobiles, Water Treatment Plants, Leather & Shoe Industries etc.

The Company is an ISO 9001: 2008 certified Company and carries out in-process and final inspection strictly to ensure that the specifications/ standards required by the customers are fully met.

The Company has not made any marketing tie up with any other company.  The products are sold directly to the customers. We have Branch Office in New Delhi, Mumbai, Ahmedabad with storage depots to cater to the needs of customers immediately on receipt of orders.
